# Abstract


## Prepare the ros connection file

Create a *JSON* file named ```IOTC_ReferenceData-prod-db.json``` with content (you will need to adapt with your own connection details):

```json
{
  "host": "localhost",
  "port": "5432",
  "dbname": "IOTC_ReferenceData_2025_07_23",
  "user": "xxx",
  "password": "xxx"
}
```

## Generate database metadata

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# Load sources
source("R/common_db_utils.R")
source("R/reference_data_db.R")
# Generate Reference data database metatadata files
generate_db_metadata(extract_db_metadata(schemas = IOTC_REFERENCE_DATA_SCHEMAS, connection_provider = connect_to_reference_data), output_directory = IOTC_REFERENCE_DATA_DB_METADATA_DIRECTORY)
```
## Update comments on database

```{r, warning = FALSE}
# Load sources
source("R/common_db_utils.R")
source("R/reference_data_db.R")
# Update for the hole Reference data database documentation
update_queries <- apply_comments_on_db(root_directory = IOTC_REFERENCE_DATADB_METADATA_DIRECTORY, connection_provider = connect_to_reference_data)
```
